name: sms-agent-router
description: Text a Twilio number and route each message to the AI agent you name: "grok ...", "claude ...". A zero-dependency Cloudflare Worker.

TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Your Twilio account Auth Token (Twilio Console home, Account Info). Used to check that each request really comes from Twilio.

OWNER_NUMBERS.description: Phone numbers allowed to use the router, with country code, comma-separated, e.g. +12125550100.

GROK_URL.description: Grok automation webhook endpoint (grok.com, Automations, Webhook trigger). Leave the placeholder if you don't use Grok.

GROK_SECRET.description: The whsec_... signing secret shown once under the Grok webhook trigger.

CLAUDE_URL.description: Claude Code routine API trigger URL (claude.ai/code/routines, Add trigger, API). Leave the placeholder if you don't use Claude.

CLAUDE_KEY.description: The sk-ant-oat01-... token generated for that routine trigger (shown once).
